sn38.16:1.1: Kiṃ nu kho āvuso Sāriputta imasmiṃ dhammavinaye dukkaranti || || Pabbajjā kho āvuso imasmiṃ dhammavinaye dukkaranti || || Pabbajjitena panāvuso kiṃ dukkaranti || || Pabbajjitena kho āvuso abhirati dukkarāti || Abhiratena panāvuso Sāriputta kiṃ dukkaranti || || Abhiratena kho āvuso dhammānudhammapaṭipatti dukkarāti || || Kiṃ va ciram panāvuso dhammānudhammapaṭipanno bhikkhu arahaṃ assāti || || Na ciram āvusoti || || Jambukhādaka-saṃyuttaṃ || || Tassuddānaṃ
sn38.16:2.0: Nibbānam Arahattañca || Dhammavādī Kimatthiyam || Assāso Paramassāso || Vedanā Āsavāvijjā || Taṇhā Oghā Upādānam || Bhavo Dukkhañca Sakkāyo || Imasmiṃ dhammavinaye Dukkaranti || ||
